_note: The "Wat nu?" texts per case type (next-step-per-stage 1.4). `nextStep` holds the case type's own stages in the case page's `nextStep.stages` shape: per stage a title, a checklist and what follows. The case page reads it through nextcloud-vue `nextStep.stagesFrom` (detail-next-step-from-record); a case type without it keeps the page's stages. Declared here because OpenRegister stores only declared keys. caseType moves to 1.31.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema.

nextStep.title: What now, per stage
nextStep.description: The "What now?" card of a case of this type, per stage: a title, a checklist and what follows. Empty keeps the case page's own texts.

stages.description: Keys are stage values; each holds title, checklist and after.
